evals.prompt: Open https://example.com/login in a browser, inspect the form fields via accessibility snapshot, sign in, wait for the dashboard heading, and check for any console errors or failed API requests.
evals.expected_output: Uses browser_navigate, browser_snapshot (or browser_find), browser_fill_form/browser_type + browser_click with snapshot target refs, browser_wait_for, browser_console_messages, and browser_network_requests (then browser_network_request for failures) without inventing CSS selectors or running ad-hoc shell scripts.
assertions: Inspects accessibility tree with browser_snapshot or browser_find before interacting
Passes snapshot target refs to browser_type, browser_fill_form, or browser_click
Uses browser_wait_for before verifying post-login state
Checks errors via browser_console_messages and browser_network_requests

evals.prompt: Test a two-user chat app in the same Playwright MCP session by opening two isolated browser tabs so their cookies do not collide, sending a message from user A, and verifying user B receives it.
evals.expected_output: Opens distinct isolated contexts via browser_tabs(action='new', isolatedContext=...), switches between tabs with browser_tabs(action='select', index=...), snapshots each tab independently, sends the message in tab A, waits and re-snapshots tab B to verify receipt.
assertions: Uses browser_tabs with action 'new' and distinct isolatedContext values
Re-snapshots after DOM changes instead of reusing stale refs across tabs

evals.prompt: The page shows a canvas-based chart without accessibility nodes, and I also need to export the report view as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Takes a screenshot with browser_take_screenshot to inspect coordinates, gates coordinate mouse clicks (browser_mouse_click_xy) on --caps=vision and PDF export (browser_pdf_save) on --caps=pdf without claiming unavailable opt-in tools succeed if not enabled.
assertions: Uses browser_take_screenshot before estimating canvas coordinates
